note: Irreducible half proved for universally open k-schemes (universal openness over a field is not in mathlib in general). The separable (geometrically reduced) half is missing: mathlib has no composition lemma for GeometricallyReduced.

Proved: k algebraically closed iff k′ ⊗_k k′ is a domain for every finite extension k′ (a domain finite over k is a field, so the multiplication k′⊗k′ → k′ is bijective and [k′:k]² = [k′:k]). Missing: the tensor product of two integral k-algebras over an algebraically closed field is integral.
Proved: geometrically integral implies X_{k′} integral for every extension. The converse implications (from X_{K_1} integral, or from finite extensions) are missing.
Matches mathlib (reduced ⊓ irreducible); integrality of X proved. The converse for k algebraically closed is not formalised.
Base change k′/k preserves geometric integrality (mathlib instance). Missing: descent from k′ to k, and the product (no composition lemma for GeometricallyReduced).
Proved: X ×_k Y is connected for X geometrically connected and universally open, Y connected. Missing: over a separably closed field every connected scheme is geometrically connected.
Affine case (X = Spec A) from mathlib; the gluing to arbitrary X is not done.
Surjectivity proved for every nonempty Y; openness for Y locally of finite presentation over k (flat, hence universally open). Universal openness of an arbitrary k-scheme is not in mathlib.
Nonemptiness of X_{k′} proved; connectedness over a separably closed field missing (see 19954).
Affine form: the primes of B over 𝔭 are the points of Spec(κ(𝔭) ⊗_A B). Mathlib defines the scheme fibre Scheme.Hom.fiber as the base change to Spec κ(y), which is the last clause.
Proved in affine form: if Spec(k′ ⊗_k k′) is connected for every finite Galois k′, then k is separably closed (k′⊗k′ ≃ k′ × T for k′ separable). The count |Γ| of points is not formalised.

Proved: geometric connectedness (mathlib) iff X_{k′} connected for every extension; it implies X ×_k Y connected for connected Y (universally open X). Missing: the equivalence with X_{K_1} connected and with finite Galois extensions.
First half proved; the converse iff k separably closed is missing.

Affine form proved: a filtered inductive limit of rings with only trivial idempotents has only trivial idempotents (Spec connected iff 0, 1 are the only idempotents). The relative (affine over quasi-compact X) case is not glued.
Product (universally open factors) and base change proved; descent along k′/k missing.
On any site (topological spaces included): the supremum of subsheaves is the sheafification of the union of subpresheaves; its sections are those lying locally in one of the F_i.
Missing carrier: the gluing of ℤ copies of a curve along the complement of a point (mathlib has Scheme.GlueData but no such construction, nor criteria for local finite type of a glued scheme).
Module form (affine, global sections) defined; coherent sheaves of modules on a ringed space are not in mathlib (only SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType and IsQuasicoherent).
Noetherian case only (coherent = finite type): stability under submodules, quotients, sums and extensions. Serre’s theorem for coherent sheaves needs coherent sheaves, not in mathlib.
Affine noetherian form: coherent = finitely presented = finite, and the ring is coherent.
First half (mathlib); the characterisation by non-reducedness of Y is not formalised.
Affine form proved (J_Y radical, V(J_Y) = Y, largest ideal defining Y); the quasi-coherent ideal sheaf and the reduced subscheme structure are not glued here.
Affine form.
Affine core: V(J) is the whole space iff J is a nil ideal. The scheme-level reduction (immersion with open image is a closed immersion into that open) is not formalised.
The direction qcqs ⇒ finite affine cover with quasi-compact intersections is proved; the converse is not.

Algebraic core: on Spec ℤ the sections over D(2) of ∏ ℤ~ are ∏ ℤ[1/2], and the canonical map (∏ ℤ)[1/2] → ∏ ℤ[1/2] is not onto ((1/2ⁿ)ₙ is not in the image), so the infinite product is not quasi-coherent.
Discussion of the preceding counterexample.

Only the key step (finitely generated torsion-free modules over a DVR are free). The bijection is not formalised. The edition’s “H ↦ M ∩ H_K” is ambiguous: the correspondence sends the kernel N of a free rank-one quotient of M to N_K, with inverse H ↦ M ∩ H (preimage in M of a hyperplane H ⊂ M_K).

Radicial = universally injective; the fibre condition is injectivity plus purely inseparable residue field extensions.
First half proved: an integral, universally injective, surjective morphism has all base changes homeomorphisms. The converse is not formalised (mathlib has no notion of universal homeomorphism).

Precise claim, treated as a proposition (same as 35338). Not formalised: needs the nodal cubic, its normalization and an open subscheme of it as schemes. Corrected: the edition's wording removed the point from the curve rather than from its normalization (cf. 35338).
